gloss: taking out the trash; garbage disposal

definitions.explanation: the act of putting garbage out for collection on designated days

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, garbage collection follows strict schedules and sorting rules. Different types of garbage are collected on different days.

COMMON GARBAGE TYPES:
- ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ / ⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧ (burnable garbage)
- {不燃|ふねん}⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ / ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧ (non-burnable garbage)
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (recyclables)
- ⟦{粗大|そだい}ゴミ→粗大ゴミ：08045_sodaigomi⟧ (bulky waste)

USAGE:
- ゴミ{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take out the trash)
- ゴミ{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (garbage collection day)
